summary: Formats the unsigned 16-bit value read from a2 as a decimal string into a 32-byte local buffer via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (0x0058815F) using the '%d' format literal, then appends that text to the destination string a1 with strcat. Returns 0 unconditionally. Invoked by UIConfigEntrySerialization (0x004B1FC0) to serialize an integer config value as text.

local_names.a1: destination string that receives the appended formatted text
local_names.a2: pointer to the unsigned 16-bit value being serialized

operations.description: Read v3 = *a2, the unsigned 16-bit value to serialize.
Initialize the 32-byte local buffer v4 with v4[0] = 0.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v4, "%d", v3) formats the value into the buffer; the '%d' literal is the read-global aD_1 at 0x005C3280 (DERIVED association from IDA naming).
strcat(a1, v4) appends the formatted decimal text to the destination string a1; strcat is an implicit CRT call not listed in the packet's callees.

unresolved: The association of the read-global aD_1 (0x005C3280) with the inline '%d' literal is DERIVED from the global's IDA naming; the packet does not pin the literal bytes directly.
strcat is reconstructed from the raw source text; it is an implicit CRT call with no packet callee evidence entry.
